messages:
Priya Nair: Quick finance heads-up: small procurement + expense updates rolling out this week. Please skim and action.
Carlos Vega: Summary?
Priya Nair: Two items: 1) Vendor approval threshold lowered to $3,000 annualized (was $5k) for Q4 pilot. 2) New temporary card rule for trial vendors.
Aisha Rahman: Lowering the threshold 1? Any reason?
Priya Nair: Pilot to tighten spend controls and reduce fragmented SaaS. We'll monitor vendor volume and onboarding time; policy reverts after Q4 unless we keep it.
Carlos Vega: How does this affect renewals?
Priya Nair: Renewals that push cumulative annual spend over $3k need re-approval and a PO. Small renewals under $3k remain manager-approved.
Aisha Rahman: Temp card rule?
Priya Nair: For trial or proof-of-concept vendors, teams can use a temporary virtual card for one charge up to $750, but you must file a vendor questionnaire within 3 business days or the charge will be disputed. Use tag `trial-vendor` in the procurement form.
Carlos Vega: Emergency needs?
Priya Nair: Emergency purchases same as before: 2-manager approvals + finance email sign-off. Log in #procurement-emergencies.
FinanceBot: :bell: Reminder scheduled  "Q4 procurement pilot" will ping managers tomorrow at 09:00.
Aisha Rahman: Who should we contact for onboarding questions?
Priya Nair: Ping procurement@redwood.com or DM me. We'll host a 20-min AMA at 3pm Thursday for managers.
Carlos Vega: Noted, will brief my PMs.
Priya Nair: Thanks 44d - appreciate the quick read.
